# BTicino C300X Integration v1.5.1

This release aligns the Home Assistant ringer volume control with the C300X
device volume scale.

## Highlights

- Uses the C300X device ringer volume scale directly as `0` to `10`, where
  `0` mutes the ringer on the device.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.5.1` so the
  ringer volume range is reported correctly.
